newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 9.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- "Grand coalition" in favour of revising law to ensure compulsory land leasing for U.S. military in Okinawa.
-- Posts & Telecommunications Ministry to push for international standardisation of multimedia technologies.
-- Dollar temporarily rises to above 126.10 yen in Tokyo, London and New York foreign currency markets.
-- Mayor of Nago in Okinawa gives conditional approval to research on hosting U.S. heliport.
-- Lower House to adopt organ transplant legislation this month.
-- Fair Trade Commission (FTC) is not likely to put cap on stock shares to be held by financial holding companies.
-- U.S. and China held a secret meeting last year to avoid confrontation over Taiwan Strait crisis.
